Messages.Author: niko...@hotmail.com
Messages.Body:
Can Permanency be played on Mirror Image when it is used as a combat
card? (Combat ends)

[chi] Only usable when this vampire plays an action modifier that
requires Chimerstry. Move that action modifier card from your ash heap
to your hand (discard down afterward). Not usable if the action
modifier was canceled as it was played. [CHI] Only usable when an
action card that requires Chimerstry is put in play. Put this card on
the action card. If the action card is burned, return it to your hand
instead (discard down afterward).

This card can be used as an action modifier or a combat card. [chi] +1
stealth . [CHI] Strike: combat ends. If this vampire was blocked while
performing an action other than bleeding, the action continues as if
unblocked.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
niko...@hotmail.com wrote:
> Can Permanency be played on Mirror Image when it is used as a combat
> card? (Combat ends)

No. Only on action modifiers or action cards.
